roots.origin: 希腊语 tekton（木匠、动手造东西的人）与 tekhnē（练出来的手艺、门道）同出一源；tekhnikos 是「合手艺的」，arkhitekton 是「匠人之长」。拉丁语 texere（编织）虽出自更古的同一支，两边在希腊语与拉丁语里已分化，库中不合并
roots.core_concept: a hand that works material into a made thing / 一双把料做成器物的手
roots.core_image: 木匠拿凿子在梁上开出一个方口，木头本来是整根的，出来时正好扣住另一根
roots.english_definition: to build with skilled hands, to craft

roots.origin: 拉丁语 dividere（切成几份、分开），过去分词 divisus，动名词 dividendum 是「该分下去的那一份」；通俗拉丁语 divisare 经古法语给出 devise 一支。其中的 -videre 表「劈开」，与表看的 videre 不是同一个词，勿混
roots.core_concept: one whole cut into separate shares / 一整块切开成分得开的几份
roots.core_image: 整块东西划一刀成两份，再往下分；难办的事也这么一段段切开，就有了下手处
roots.english_definition: to split into parts, to divide up

roots.origin: 拉丁语 stinguere（用尖头戳、戳灭），与 instigare（催逼）同支；exstinguere 是戳到火星不剩，distinguere 是逐个戳上记号使分得开，instinguere 是从里头戳一下把人催动
roots.core_concept: to prick with a point, and so to mark off or put out / 用尖头戳，因而戳出记号或戳灭
roots.core_image: 针尖往下一戳：戳出记号便分得清，火苗上一戳只剩焦痕，心上那一戳是天生的
roots.english_definition: to prick, to mark off or put out by pricking

roots.origin: 拉丁语 -minere（凸出、探出来），只见于复合词 eminere（高出四周）与 prominere（朝前探出）；与 mons（属格 montis，山）同一个词干，minae（城墙上探出的雉堞）与 minari（威吓）亦出此支——探在头顶的东西自然压人
roots.core_concept: standing out above the level around it / 从四周的平面上鼓出来、比周围高
roots.core_image: 平地上鼓起一大块，远远就看见它高过四周；走到跟前抬头，它正压在头顶上
roots.english_definition: to jut out, to stand above the surroundings

roots.origin: 希腊语 demos（一个地方的民众、一区之民）；demokratia 是 demos 加 kratos（权力）——事情由这一片人说了算；epidemia 是 epi-（落在其上）加 demos，指落到一地之人头上的东西
roots.core_concept: the people of one place taken together / 一个地方的人合起来算
roots.core_image: 一个区的人都聚到院子里，抬手数过就算定了；一场病也是从这户挨到那户
roots.english_definition: the people of a district, the common people

concepts.concept: a hand that works material into a made thing
concepts.core_image: 木匠拿凿子在梁上开出一个方口，木头本来是整根的，出来时正好扣住另一根

concepts.concept: one whole cut into separate shares
concepts.core_image: 整块东西划一刀成两份，再往下分；难办的事也这么一段段切开，就有了下手处

concepts.concept: to prick with a point, and so to mark off or put out
concepts.core_image: 针尖往下一戳：戳出记号便分得清，火苗上一戳只剩焦痕，心上那一戳是天生的

concepts.concept: standing out above the level around it
concepts.core_image: 平地上鼓起一大块，远远就看见它高过四周；走到跟前抬头，它正压在头顶上

concepts.concept: the people of one place taken together
concepts.core_image: 一个区的人都聚到院子里，抬手数过就算定了；一场病也是从这户挨到那户

words.root_logic: techn（tekhnē 练出来的门道）+ -ique（名词后缀）→ 把这件事做成的那一套固定做法
words.origin: 法语 technique ← 希腊语 tekhnikos（合手艺的）← tekhnē（练出来的门道）
words.native_definition: a particular way of doing something skilfully
words.core_concept: a settled way of getting the thing made – 把东西做成的那一套固定做法
words.core_image: 同一把刀，他握的角度和下刀的次序每回都不变，切出来每片一样厚
examples: She has perfect technique in the water.
He learned the technique from an old carpenter.
semantic_expansions: 技巧：手上练出来、每回都能做得一样准的那份本事
技法：一门手艺里定下来的步骤和讲究
手法：同一套做法用到不算手艺的事情上
words.recall_hint: techn（练出的门道）+ -ique → 把这件事做成的那一套固定动作

words.root_logic: techn（tekhnē 门道）+ -ical（…的）→ 属于某一行门道之内的
words.origin: 希腊语 tekhnikos（合手艺的）← tekhnē（练出来的门道），英语加 -al 构成形容词
words.native_definition: relating to the practical skills or knowledge of a particular subject
words.core_concept: belonging inside the know-how of a trade – 属于某一行门道之内的
words.core_image: 说明书翻到第三页全是参数和接线图，外行看两行就放下了
examples: The report is full of technical terms.
We hit a technical problem with the software.
semantic_expansions: 技术的：与那一行具体门道有关的
专业的：只有行内人看得懂，外人插不上话
words.recall_hint: techn（门道）+ -ical → 属于某一行门道之内，外行进不来

words.root_logic: techn（tekhnē 门道）+ -logy（成体系的学问）→ 把手上门道整理成一整套学问和器具
words.origin: 希腊语 tekhnologia（把手艺讲成条理）← tekhnē（练出来的门道）+ -logia（成体系的学问）
words.native_definition: the use of scientific knowledge to make equipment and methods for practical work
words.core_concept: craft know-how worked up into a system – 把手上门道整理成一整套学问和器具
words.core_image: 一屋子设备连成一条线，按下按钮，原先要十个人干的活自己走完了
examples: New technology has changed how we work.
The factory uses the latest technology.
semantic_expansions: 技术：整理成体系、照着就能用的那套门道
科技：这套门道与科学知识合在一处说
工艺：一处生产里定下来的那串具体做法
words.recall_hint: techn（门道）+ -logy（成体系的学问）→ 手上门道理成一整套学问和器具

words.root_logic: techn（tekhnē 门道）+ -ian（做这行的人）→ 手里握着那一行具体门道的人
words.origin: 英语 technic ← 希腊语 tekhnikos（合手艺的）← tekhnē（练出来的门道），加 -ian 表做这行的人
words.native_definition: someone trained to work with particular equipment or in a particular field
words.core_concept: the person who holds the trade know-how – 手里握着那一行具体门道的人
words.core_image: 机器停了，来的人蹲下拧开面板，摸两下就说出该换哪个件
examples: A technician came to fix the printer.
She works as a lab technician.
semantic_expansions: 技术员：真正上手干这行活的那个人
技师：同一种人，偏说他资历深、手更熟
words.recall_hint: techn（门道）+ -ian（做这行的人）→ 手里握着那一行具体门道的人

words.root_logic: divid（dividere 切成几份）→ 把整块划开成几份
words.origin: 拉丁语 dividere（切成几份、分开），过去分词 divisus，经中古英语入现代英语
words.native_definition: to separate something into parts, or to share something out
words.core_concept: cutting one whole into separate shares – 把一整块切成分得开的几份
words.core_image: 他拿刀在饼上划了三道，四个人各拿走一块
examples: We divided the cake into eight pieces.
The river divides the town in two.
semantic_expansions: 分开：一样东西成了两样或几样
划分：在整块上定出界线，各归各处
分配：把切下来的几份发到各人手上
除以：算术里把一个数照份切匀
collocations: divide sth into sth —— 把某物分成若干份
divide sth between/among sb —— 在若干人之间分派某物
be divided on sth —— 在某事上各执一边
words.recall_hint: divid（切开）→ 把整块划成几份，各归各处

words.root_logic: in-（不）+ dividu（dividere 切开）+ -al → 再切下去就没有了的那一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 individuus（切不下去的）：in-（不）+ dividere（切成几份）；英语后转指单独的一个人
words.native_definition: single and separate; also a single person
words.core_concept: the one that cannot be cut any further – 再切下去就没有了的那一个
words.core_image: 队伍散开后，每人手里一张写着自己名字的表，谁也不能替谁填
examples: Each individual receives a separate copy.
We looked at individual cases one by one.
semantic_expansions: 个人的：只属于这一个人，不属于那一群
单独的：一个一个地算，不整批地算
个体：切到不能再切的那一个本身
words.recall_hint: in-（不）+ dividu（切开）+ -al → 再切下去就没有了的那一个

words.root_logic: divid（dividere 切成几份）+ -end（该被…的）→ 该分下去的那一笔
words.origin: 拉丁语 dividendum（该分下去之物），dividere（切成几份）的动名词
words.native_definition: a part of a company profits paid to the people who own its shares
words.core_concept: the sum marked out to be divided up – 划出来准备分下去的那一笔
words.core_image: 年底结账，账上多出来的钱按各人持股照比例打进户头
examples: The company paid a small dividend this year.
Shareholders expect a higher dividend next quarter.
semantic_expansions: 股息：按持股定期分到手的那一份
红利：赚得多时额外再分出来的那一笔
被除数：算术里等着被切匀的那个数
words.recall_hint: divid（切开）+ -end（该被…的）→ 划出来该分下去的那一笔

words.root_logic: ex-（出、尽）+ stingu（stinguere 用尖头戳）+ -ish → 一下下戳到一点火星不剩
words.origin: 拉丁语 exstinguere（戳到不剩）：ex-（出、尽）+ stinguere（用尖头戳、戳灭），英语按法语式加 -ish
words.native_definition: to make a fire or light stop burning, or to end something completely
words.core_concept: pricked down until no spark is left – 戳到一点火星也不剩
words.core_image: 他用湿布往炭上一压，红点先暗下一片，抬手时只剩一缕白气
examples: Firefighters extinguished the blaze within an hour.
She extinguished the candle before leaving.
semantic_expansions: 扑灭：正烧着的火被压下去
熄灭：灯烛上那一点亮被按掉
消灭：念头或指望也这样被按到不剩
words.recall_hint: ex-（尽）+ stingu（戳）→ 一下下戳到一点火星也不剩

words.root_logic: in-（在里头）+ stinct（stinguere 戳）→ 里头戳的那一下，不等想就动了
words.origin: 拉丁语 instinctus（受催动），instinguere 的过去分词：in-（在里头）+ stinguere（用尖头戳、催逼）
words.native_definition: a natural tendency to behave in a certain way without having to learn it
words.core_concept: a prick from inside that moves you before thought – 里头戳的那一下，比想还快
words.core_image: 杯子刚从桌沿滑下去，手已经伸出去接住了，脑子还没转过来
examples: Birds build nests by instinct alone.
Her first instinct was to run away.
semantic_expansions: 本能：不用学就会的那种反应
天性：生下来就扎在里头的那种脾性
直觉：不经推理、当下就冒出来的那个判断
collocations: by instinct —— 出于本能地，不经思考
have an instinct for sth —— 对某事有天生的感觉
sb's first instinct is to do sth —— 某人的第一反应是做某事
words.recall_hint: in-（在里头）+ stinct（戳）→ 里头戳的那一下，比想还快

words.root_logic: ex-（出、尽）+ stinct（stinguere 戳）→ 被戳尽了，一支再也接不下去
words.origin: 拉丁语 exstinctus，exstinguere（戳到不剩）的过去分词：ex-（尽）+ stinguere（用尖头戳、戳灭）
words.native_definition: no longer existing as a species, or no longer active
words.core_concept: pricked out with nothing left burning – 戳尽了，一支接不下去
words.core_image: 馆里玻璃柜摆着一副骨架，标签写着最后一次见到它是哪一年
examples: That bird became extinct fifty years ago.
The volcano has been extinct for centuries.
semantic_expansions: 灭绝的：一支活物到某一年就断了
绝种的：同一件事，偏说没有后代留下
不再活动的：火山那样，里头那点火早已按掉
collocations: become extinct —— 灭绝、绝种，最常用
an extinct volcano —— 死火山，固定说法
words.recall_hint: ex-（尽）+ stinct（戳）→ 戳尽了，那一支再也接不下去

words.root_logic: pro-（朝前）+ minent（minere 凸出）→ 朝前鼓出来，一眼先看见它
words.origin: 拉丁语 prominens，prominere（朝前探出）的现在分词：pro-（朝前）+ -minere（凸出、探出来）
words.native_definition: important and well known, or easily seen because it sticks out
words.core_concept: jutting forward so it is seen first – 朝前鼓出来，一眼先看见
words.core_image: 一块板上的钉子都齐平，只有一颗头冒出来半分，袖子过去就被挂住
examples: He played a prominent part in the reform.
A prominent sign hung above the door.
semantic_expansions: 突出的：位置上真的鼓出来，摸得到
显著的：因为鼓出来，远处一眼也认得出
杰出的：人在同行里也这样高出一截
collocations: play a prominent part/role in sth —— 在某事中起重要作用
a prominent figure —— 知名人物
words.recall_hint: pro-（朝前）+ minent（凸出）→ 朝前鼓出来，一眼先看见它

words.root_logic: menac（minae 探在头顶的东西 ← minere 凸出）→ 悬在上头压着人，不敢往下走
words.origin: 古法语 menace ← 通俗拉丁语 minacia ← 拉丁语 minae（城墙上探出的雉堞，转指威吓），与 -minere（凸出）同支
words.native_definition: something or someone likely to cause harm; to threaten someone
words.core_concept: something jutting overhead that presses on you – 探在头顶上、压着人的那样东西
words.core_image: 站在崖底往上看，一块岩石探出头顶，缝里还落着碎屑，人不由得加快脚步
examples: Drunk drivers are a menace to everyone.
He menaced the boy with a stick.
semantic_expansions: 威胁：悬在上头、随时可能落下来的那件事
危险的人：把这种悬着的东西说成一个人
恐吓：作动词，把这份压力朝人压过去
collocations: a menace to sb/sth —— 对某人某物构成祸害
menace sb with sth —— 用某物恐吓某人
words.recall_hint: menac（探在头顶）→ 悬在上头压着人，不敢往下走

words.root_logic: demos（一地之民）+ -cracy（kratos 权力）→ 权力落在这一片人手里
words.origin: 希腊语 demokratia：demos（一个地方的民众）+ kratos（权力），经法语 démocratie 入英语
words.native_definition: a system in which people choose their government by voting
words.core_concept: power held in the hands of the people – 权力落在众人手里，不在一个人手里
words.core_image: 全村人聚在院子里，抬手的一个个数过，哪边多就照哪边办
examples: Democracy depends on free and fair elections.
The country returned to democracy after ten years.
semantic_expansions: 民主：事情由众人一起表决定下来这件事
民主制度：把这种定法固定成一整套安排
words.recall_hint: demos（一地之民）+ -cracy（权力）→ 权力落在这一片人手里，不在一个人手里

words.root_logic: demos（一地之民）+ -cratic（kratos 权力）→ 权力在众人手里的，人人都插得上话
words.origin: 希腊语 demokratikos ← demokratia：demos（一个地方的民众）+ kratos（权力），经法语 démocratique 入英语
words.native_definition: based on the principle that all members have an equal say
words.core_concept: run by the say of all, not of one – 由众人说了算，不由一个人说了算
words.core_image: 会上谁想说话抬手就行，主持的人等所有人讲完才落笔
examples: They held a democratic vote on the issue.
She has a very democratic management style.
semantic_expansions: 民主的：由众人一起表决定下来的
有民主作风的：说人愿意让旁人开口，不一个人拍板
words.recall_hint: demos（一地之民）+ -cratic（权力）→ 权力在众人手里，人人插得上话
